description:
The keyword tail on an extern head (parse_extern_raises), ExternRaises on FunctionSurface, contract validation, ExternReturn::Checked(lane, LastResort), the wrapper's failure edge (Term::Raise with the declared atom and message, atom interned via collect_executable_atoms), the interpreter's CheckedFailure -> raise_last_resort. Kernel's arithmetic externs converted; arithmetic_result, checked_result_lane and LastResort::arithmetic_error deleted. drive_test pins re-measured (drops only). An interpolated message: gives a clear diagnostic.

Validation is loud, one fixture per diagnostic: non-C ABI ('needs the C ABI'); a return that is not integer, float or boolean; a non-alias exception name; an interpolated message.

Fails before, passes after, on interp, run and build: a body maxint + 1 and rem(7, 0) raise ArithmeticError with Elixir's first line and exit 1; a user extern with raises: MyApp.DivisionByZero raises that exception; the step/r program has 15 native functions (25 before).

Untested in the spike, test here: a float payload on AOT; a boolean payload (needs a runtime symbol returning {bool, bool}, or the boolean case is removed from validation if nothing uses it).

Docs: .agent/docs/externs.md and the user guide for externs.

Acceptance: full gate green; every pin edit is a drop or is in the page's must-change list.
title: Externs declare a failure with raises:, used in bodies
